note: Ozark hills along the Meramec and Huzzah Creek southeast of Leasburg. The primitive camping area is along a gravel lane loop near the Huzzah Creek boat ramp in the south of the area, with a privy by the ramp. The area brochure (2026) allows camping only from September 15 to May 15, day use the rest of the year. Horses are not allowed in the camping area. --Claude
